title: Frequent Questions Related to Hazardous Waste Recycling, the Definition of Solid Waste and Other Exemptions and Exclusions
key_requirements: Processed scrap metal, unprocessed home scrap metal and unprocessed prompt scrap metal are not solid waste and not subject to Subtitle C when recycled (40 CFR 261.4(a)(13)). Recycled scrap metal that is not excluded is still not subject to 40 CFR Parts 262-266, 268, 270 or 124 or RCRA 3010 notification (40 CFR 261.6(a)(3)(ii)).
